# The Station Under Any Name

Version 1.9.1 keeps the open/closed status working when you rename a station's status sensor.

## Fixes

- **A renamed status sensor is still found.** The card looked for the sensor by its entity ID ending in `_status`. If you renamed it, for example to `binary_sensor.aral_open`, the card showed "Status unknown", and "Hide Closed Stations" kept a closed station on the list. The card now also recognises the sensor by the type Home Assistant gives it. Thanks to @SeoFood _[#101]_.

Nothing to change after updating.
